_comment: Column knowledge for <code>.vert.tsv, per tools/PIPELINE.md § vert.tsv columns. Consumed by tools/csvw/generate_csvw.py. Column *sets* are not fully uniform even within one directory — e.g. KIParla-collection/tsv has both a 12-column shape and a 13-column shape (with/without `variation`) — so this is a lookup of descriptions/datatypes by column name, not a fixed ordered list. The generator groups files by their real header and builds one schema per distinct shape.

token_id.dc:description: TU_ID-TOKEN_IDX, assigned at creation. Stable and creation-order — not guaranteed monotonic within a TU after a split/add (use `id` for true order, where present).

unit.dc:description: DEPRECATED — pure duplicate of tu_id, superseded by `id`. Still present in files no patch has touched yet; dropped by tools/make_patch.py as each conversation is repatched. See tools/PIPELINE.md.

id.dc:description: Token's true 0-based position within its TU. Recomputed from row order on every patch — always monotonic, unlike token_id.

span.dc:description: Raw Jefferson span (character slice of the original annotation).

form.dc:description: Normalized form: lowercase, no prolongations, no punctuation.

upos.dc:description: Universal POS tag. Filled by the lemmatization step.

type.dc:description: Token type flag (tools/dataflags.py:tokentype). Current code emits linguistic|shortpause|nonverbalbehavior|error|warning|unknown|anonymized, but this is not enforced as a hard constraint — the code enum has drifted before (see `code-variation` below) and existing files may lag it.

code-variation.dc:description: All variation features of the token, pipe-separated Key=Value: `ContainsVariation=Yes|No` (unit level, repeated on every token row of the unit; always present), `Code=Other|Unsure|Underspecified`, `Language=<ISO code|NO_ISO_CODE>`, `Nonce=Yes`. Replaces the old `variation` column (a single label none|yes|unspecified|all|some, later a feature list with `Variety=Other|Unassignable|Unsure`); the current tools refuse to read the old format.

jefferson_feats.dc:description: Pipe-separated: Intonation=X, Interrupted=Yes, Truncated=Yes, Reduced=Yes, ProsodicLink=Yes, SpaceAfter=No, PauseAfter=Yes, Anonymized=Yes, Volume=X, Syllables=N. (Variation features — Code, Language, Nonce — are in the `code-variation` column.)

align.dc:description: Begin=X / End=X / Begin=X|End=X for the first/last token of a TU.

guesses.dc:description: 0-3(0),... — genuine 'hard to understand' spans only; see PIPELINE.md for the reduction_words whitelist interaction.
